about: Mochi's poses from TamagotchiCore's PetPoseEvaluator (mochi_world's port must match): each case is an animation, a variant (or none: picked from the start time and seed), an optional slot duration and a context; each sample is the elapsed time t, the global time and the pose. Numbers have 12 significant digits; pose values equal to the defaults are left out. Seeds are unsigned 64-bit decimals. Regenerate with MOCHI_WRITE_WORLD_FIXTURES=1 swift test --filter WorldFixture.
